title: Caleb Dunne
summary: A Division Agent and the lead character of Extremis Malis, whose pursuit of Mantis follows a fatal New York warehouse operation into the Division 2 prequel's East Coast story.

claims.text: Extremis Malis identifies Caleb Dunne as a Division Agent and its central pursuing character.
After Mathias Kaminsky is killed during a Chinatown warehouse encounter, Caleb follows the operative known as Mantis through Philadelphia and toward Washington.

paragraphs.text: Caleb begins the graphic novel as a Division Agent on a Chinatown warehouse operation. The killing of his partner turns the case into a pursuit that carries the prequel beyond Manhattan.

verification.notes: Character and plot outcome are source-specific to the licensed graphic novel and are marked major spoiler.
